## Highlights

- Use the native Wails desktop to author tasks, manage automation sources, inspect schedules and activity, and retain accessible preferences.
- Deliver isolated webhook notifications and optional observe-first local MCP access without changing task outcomes or local offline defaults.
- Connect desktop, CLI, and direct JSON clients to explicitly enabled TLS 1.3 daemons through pinned identities, pairing, capabilities, and audit records.
- Trust one cumulative release staged only after exact-commit CI and promoted only after candidate-bound Windows fresh-install and v1.1.1-upgrade qualification.

Read the [full changelog](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/blob/v1.4.0/CHANGELOG.md#140---2026-09-10) for every change.
